model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories of specialists involved in the implementation of projects under the "Passive House" standard, based on their level of preparation and qualification. The chart is divided into four distinct segments, each represented by a different color and labeled with a percentage. The largest segment, colored green, accounts for 51% and represents the "Smallest part of the implementers/designers who are prepared to implement projects under the Passive House standard, but need additional training for implementation." The second largest segment, colored red, represents 23% and corresponds to "Only a part of the implementers/designers who are prepared to implement projects under the Passive House standard." A similarly sized purple segment, also at 23%, indicates "Prepared and well-qualified ones who, with the implementation of projects under the Passive House standard." The smallest segment, a thin blue slice at 3%, represents "There are enough prepared and qualified specialists for the implementation of the Passive House standard." The chart includes a legend on the right side, clearly associating each color with its corresponding category description, and the percentage values are displayed directly within each slice of the pie.
